q2_gaps: a PERIODICITY adverb with no stated period ('periodically', and the same family: 'intermittently', 'regularly', 'occasionally at intervals'): it is not on the frequency-strength dial (always / usually / often / sometimes / rarely), Every and TimesPer both require a stated period or rate, and Manner is barred, so the instruction set's only move is to drop it — the recurrence claim is silently lost
notes: 'The Council' correctly takes the capitalized-common-noun default (witness plus type atom, no Name, no GroupOf) and, as a singular collective, does not distribute; 'begins a fresh ledger' is rightly an ordinary transitive event rather than the inceptive-aspect form, which needs an activity complement. Dropping 'periodically' is what the instruction set prescribes for an unrepresentable frequency adverbial, so it is a gap rather than a parse defect.
